title: 第十九章 缉违堂问罪第二十章 有人设局
slug: 坟头开铺我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
lines: 燕不归不是梁二叔请来的救兵。
但他一出现，梁二叔还是像看见了一线生机。
玄司缉违堂五个字，在人间富户眼里，比鬼更麻烦。鬼闹一夜，银子能压；族里出了丑事，关起门也能瞒。
可缉违堂一进门，账本、家产、祖坟、命案，全得摊在日头底下，一桩都盖不住。
梁二叔怕缉违堂。
可他更想用缉违堂压死沈清萝。
燕不归不是梁二叔请来的救兵。这一点，沈清萝很快就看出来了。
他没有听梁二叔哭诉，也没有先扣沈清萝。进祠堂后，他只让人把梁家大门封住，再让两个役吏接管证物。
梁二叔急声道：“燕捕头，沈清萝私动祖坟，纵鬼逼供，我梁家......”
燕不归看都没看他。
“闭嘴!”
梁二叔像被一巴掌抽在脸上。
沈清萝心里稍微舒服了一点。
这人虽然欠揍，但至少不蠢。
燕不归看向沈清萝。
“引魂铃。”
沈清萝没有动。
她腰间的引魂铃里，现在有春桃、梁正德、小煞灵，还有阿青的一缕魂丝。哪一个都不是能随便摊出来给人戳的。
谢无咎站在她身侧，眼神已经冷下去。
燕不归像没看见。
“告发文书写你私藏逃煞。我只查逃煞残魂，不动你其他契魂。”
阿青从铃里探出半张脸。
“你最好说话算话。我们阿萝记仇，还记账。”
燕不归看她一眼。
“知道。”
沈清萝这才解下引魂铃。
谢无咎忽然开口。
“我看着。”
燕不归皱眉：“玄司查验，不必外人插手。”
谢无咎没有解释。
宋砚不知何时站到他身后，声音压得极低。
“是否出令？”
燕不归耳尖微动，眼神终于变了。
谢无咎道：“不必。”
两个字落下，燕不归重新看了他一眼。
那一眼很短，却足够他把某些猜测压回喉咙里。
梁二叔没听清他们说什么，只以为沈清萝带来的“伙计”吓住了缉违堂，立刻道：“燕捕头，这男人也有问题！他煞气重得不像活人，沈清萝带他进我梁家，难道玄司不查？”
燕不归终于看向梁二叔。
“查不查，轮不到你教。”
梁二叔闭嘴了。
沈清萝把引魂铃悬在供桌上。
燕不归取出一枚银针，针尾有缉违堂印记。他先点铃口，再点小煞灵魂火外沿。小煞灵缩成一团，怕得发抖。
沈清萝皱眉。
content_en:
Yan Bugui was not the reinforcements invited by Uncle Liang.
But as soon as he appeared, Uncle Liang still seemed to see a glimmer of hope.
The words "Xuansi Jifatang" are more troublesome than ghosts in the eyes of rich people in the world. A night of ghosts can be suppressed by money; if something scandalous happens in the clan, it can be hidden behind closed doors.
But as soon as you enter the Jiviol Hall, the account books, family property, ancestral graves, and murder cases are all spread out under the sun, and none of them can be covered.
Second Uncle Liang was afraid of being arrested for violating the law.
But he even wanted to use Jifa Hall to crush Shen Qingluo to death.
Yan Bugui was not the reinforcements invited by Uncle Liang. Shen Qingluo quickly saw this.
He didn't listen to Uncle Liang's cry, nor did he detain Shen Qingluo first. After entering the ancestral hall, he only asked people to seal the door of Liang's family, and then asked two servants to take over the evidence.
Second Uncle Liang said anxiously: "Yan arrests the head, Shen Qingluo secretly tampered with the ancestral graves, and used ghosts to force confessions. My Liang family..."
Yan Bugui didn't even look at him.
"Shut up!"
Uncle Liang felt like he had been slapped in the face.
Shen Qingluo felt a little more comfortable.
Although this guy deserves a beating, at least he's not stupid.
Yan Bugui looked at Shen Qingluo.
"Soul-inducing bell."
Shen Qingluo didn't move.
In the soul-inducing bell around her waist, there are now Chuntao, Liang Zhengde, Xiao Shaling, and a wisp of Ah Qing's soul. None of them can be laid out casually and poked at.
Xie Wujiu stood beside her, his eyes already cold.
Yan Bugui didn't seem to see it.
"The report states that you are secretly hiding the escaped evil spirit. I will only search for the remaining soul of the escaped evil spirit, and will not touch your other contracted souls."
Ah Qing poked half of his face out of the bell.
"You'd better keep your word. We, A Luo, hold grudges and keep accounts."
Yan Bugui glanced at her.
"I know."
Shen Qingluo then took off the soul-inducing bell.
Xie Wujiu suddenly spoke.
"I'm watching."
Yan Bugui frowned: "Xuan Si inspects it, there is no need for outsiders to intervene."
Xie Wujiu didn't explain.
Song Yan stood behind him at some point and kept his voice extremely low.
"Do you want to issue an order?"
Yan Bugui's ears twitched slightly, and his eyes finally changed.
Xie Wujiu said: "No need."
After these two words fell, Yan Bugui looked at him again.
That glance was short, but it was enough for him to push some of his guesses back into his throat.
Uncle Liang didn't hear what they were saying clearly. He just thought that the "guys" brought by Shen Qingluo had frightened Ji Huitang, and immediately said: "Captain Yan, there is something wrong with this man! He is so evil that he doesn't look alive. Shen Qingluo brought him into my Liang family. Didn't Xuan Si investigate?"
Yan Bugui finally looked at Uncle Liang.
"Check or not, it's not your turn to teach."
Uncle Liang shut up.
Shen Qingluo hung the soul-inducing bell on the altar table.
Yan Bugui took out a silver needle with the mark of Ji Feitang on the end of the needle. He lit the bell first, and then lit the outer edge of Xiaosha's soul fire. The little evil spirit huddled up and trembled with fear.
Shen Qingluo frowned.
